key_points: JPMorgan and peers are offloading AI-related debt, signaling rising credit risk and investor wariness.
Policy changes may shift liability to bank customers, creating potential operational and legal pressures.
Higher UK banking taxes prompt JPM to reconsider investments, hinting at reduced profitability outlook.
Insider sale by a congresswoman could weigh on short‑term sentiment despite limited size.
Overall AI debt exposure and regulatory headwinds suggest a modest downside risk over the coming weeks to months.
